problem_closed: Runtime evidence promotion no longer accepts caller-authored expected-stage identity; the expected production, repertory contract, and UTC hour are derived from the validated canonical repertory and deterministic selector.

design_decision.observed: The prior promotion gate compared evidence against an expectedStage object supplied by its caller.
design_decision.inferred: A caller could author a self-consistent but non-canonical expectedStage and bypass the repertory selector as the source of truth.
design_decision.experiment: Compose the canonical repertory validator and hourly selector directly ahead of the existing freshness and expected-identity promotion gate.
design_decision.current_decision: Promotion derives expected identity from repertory.contract_id and the selector result for checkedAt.getUTCHours(); malformed repertories and identity divergence fail closed.

rollback: Stop consuming promoteRuntimeStageFromRepertory.v1.cjs and return to the untouched caller-supplied expected-stage promotion gate; revert the additive implementation, test, and record commits if removal is required.
next_action: Wire the canonical repertory-bound promotion function into the retained runtime-evidence promotion path, then exercise selector to freshness to promotion against one immutable successful Vercel deployment after provider capacity returns.
